messages:
kevin: quick flag release-bot tagged batching-service v0.9.0 from a tiny docs + example tweak. I think this should be v0.8.3 (patch).
anya: good catch. bot currently treats any change that touches `pkg/` or `internal/` as minor, but docs/examples should be patch.
release-bot: Release created by releasebot/auto-bump. PR #798: docs/examples update. Diff: docs/*, examples/bench/README.md, docker/README.md. No code changes under `cmd/`, `pkg/`, `internal/`. Proposed tag: v0.9.0.
tim: why did it pick minor? maybe because examples/bench/ lives under `examples/bench` which isn't whitelisted.
kevin: Exactly. Examples often live with code but aren't user-facing changes. We should refine path rules.
anya: Proposal for bot heuristics: 1) first check PR body label `release:` if present, 2) if labels include `chore/docs` or `docs` => patch, 3) path whitelist: docs/, website/, examples/*, *.md => patch, 4) scan changelog or PR title for `feat:`/`BREAKING` => escalate.
tim: Also support an explicit opt-in `release: minor` in PR body for maintainers who want to force it.
ops-signal: ops note: several enterprise customers subscribe to minor release channels; a spurious minor can trigger rollouts. prefer conservative defaults.
kevin: Action: Sophie/CI team add label + path checks to release-bot. Also include a short `reason:` line in release notes (e.g., "converted to patch because docs-only").
release-bot: ACK. Will include changed-paths and PR labels in release body, plus escalation reason when bumped to minor/major.
anya: For today, can someone delete v0.9.0 and cut v0.8.3? I can do it in 10m.
tim: I can help monitor pins and alert SRE if any downstream sees unexpected changes.
kevin: Thanks. Please also add a quick unit test for the bot heuristic (docs-only => patch).
ops-signal: thumbs-up from ops. Keep us posted when patch is live.
kevin: I'll follow up with a tiny RFC outlining heuristics and an opt-out PR body convention. Closing after patch confirmed. :white_check_mark:
